summary.en: Plasma-derived therapies and new delivery formats dominate development, alongside a smaller recombinant antibody effort. The selected programs span late-stage protein therapy and early GigaGen candidates.
summary.zh: 开发以血浆来源疗法和新型给药形式为主,另有规模较小的重组抗体项目。所选项目涵盖后期蛋白疗法和早期 GigaGen 候选药物。

watch.en: SPARTA alpha-1 efficacy topline results are expected by year-end 2026.
watch.zh: SPARTA α1 疗效顶线结果预计在 2026 年底前公布。

watch.en: Immunoglobulins led Q3 growth, increasing 11.3% at constant currency.
watch.zh: 免疫球蛋白带动第三季度增长,按固定汇率计增长 11.3%。

watch.en: Q3 net leverage was 3.98x; liquidity was EUR 2.14 billion.
watch.zh: 第三季度净杠杆率为 3.98x;流动性为 EUR 2.14 billion。

watch.en: Egypt targets around one million liters of collected plasma in 2026.
watch.zh: 埃及 2026 年的血浆采集目标约为一百万升。
